title: Magnetically aligned dust and SiO maser polarisation in the envelope of the red supergiant VY Canis Majoris
question: What do the linear and circular polarization of SiO lines and of the dust continuum from VY CMa reveal about the magnetic field and dust alignment in its envelope?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 0.1 mJy/beam; line rms ~3.8 mJy/beam (spw 3,4), ~1.4 mJy/beam (spw 2)

what.value: Band 7/9 continuum structure and clump C size, dust analysis

evidence.quote: Taking the dust mass derived from our measured fluxes, the size of clump C from OG+15, and assuming a gas-to-dust ratio of $100$

what.value: SiO Einstein A coefficients and energies

evidence.quote: along with their transition energy and Einstein $A$ coefficients (cite: Muller2001)

recipe.method: Standard ALMA calibration plus polarization calibration, self-cal on SiO maser, imaging in Stokes I,Q,U,V
Deconvolve star and clump C; derive fractional polarization and EVPA
Spectra of Stokes I, linear fraction, EVPA and V at the peak intensity

recipe.goal: Derive maser magnetic field from circular polarization
recipe.method: Zeeman: B ≈1.3 Pc cosθ, and fit V = z B cosθ dI/dν
key_parameters: maser linewidth ~1 km/s; z≈1500 s^-1 G^-1
assumptions: Zeeman origin of circular polarization; field reversals at Vlsr~15 and 30 km/s

recipe.goal: Lower limit of field for grain alignment
recipe.method: Compare Larmor timescale with gas-dust timescale (Hoang & Lazarian 2009)
key_parameters: a=0.1 micron, s=0.5, Td=Tg=100 K, n_g≈9e9 cm^-3

evidence.quote: we measure a total flux of $36\pm3$ mJy for the star
The average (non-rotated) electric vector position angle (EVPA) is $8\pm4^\circ$ (East of North)

answer_key.quantity: Magnetic field from circular polarization, B/cosθ
Minimum field for dust alignment in clump C

evidence.quote: the estimated clump C dust mass is $>1.2\times10^{-3}$ M$_\odot$

not_stated_but_needed: Exact CASA tasks and parameters for imaging (cell size, image size, masks, deconvolver, niter)
Reference antenna and self-calibration solution intervals
Method of two-component deconvolution for clump C and star fluxes
Aperture used for the extended SiO v=0 spectra
Debiasing of polarized intensity and thresholds
missing_for_reproduction: Aperture definitions for extended SiO emission
score_reason: Public SV data and clear analytic formulas, but imaging and extraction details are largely deferred to a memo or unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Public SV data, numeric results (fluxes, EVPA, polarization fractions, B estimates) with described recipe.
